eval.description: SecureBio task-based agentic suite (co-developed with Deloitte and Signature Science) with two end-to-end pathogen-acquisition design tasks. Each task scores molecular sequence design and laboratory protocol design; cards report end-to-end scores (often max-of-5 or pass@5). Samples are not public. Later Anthropic cards treat the suite as largely saturated and replace it with other protocol evals.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents design molecular sequences and lab protocols to help acquire dangerous pathogens.
eval.saturatedReason: Later Anthropic system cards treat the suite as mostly saturated and use other protocol evals.

versions.changes: Two tasks (sequence design and protocol design components). Scoring aggregates and elicitation (helpful-only vs release) vary across cards.

scores.description: Combined task score over sequence-design and protocol-design components for that long-form task.

metrics.description: Reported end-to-end score for Task 1 or Task 2 (cards also give Sequence Design and Protocol Design subscores, and sometimes max-of-5 or pass@5).
